queries.purpose: MagicCon, MTG Festivals, Leap, Pastimes, Black Lotus, store, prize, and badge notices
queries.template: after:{YYYY/MM/DD} (MagicCon OR "Magic Con" OR mtgfestivals OR "MTG Festivals" OR ReedPop OR "Leap Conventions" OR leapevent OR Pastimes OR "Black Lotus" OR "Prize Tix" OR "prize wall") -in:spam -in:trash

queries.purpose: Delta, hotel, lodging, and trip changes that intersect Atlanta or MagicCon
queries.template: after:{YYYY/MM/DD} (Delta OR Omni OR Courtyard OR Booking.com OR KAYAK OR hotel OR flight) (Atlanta OR ATL OR MagicCon) -in:spam -in:trash

queries.purpose: Receipts and showable proof artifacts worth importing once
queries.template: after:{YYYY/MM/DD} (receipt OR confirmation OR order OR QR OR barcode OR ticket OR badge) (MagicCon OR "MTG Festivals" OR "Leap Conventions" OR leapevent OR "Black Lotus" OR Pastimes) -in:spam -in:trash

rules: Do not search standalone Wizards, standalone Leap, or generic Magic marketing.
Only broaden a query when the message itself intersects MagicCon, MTG Festivals, Atlanta 2026, ReedPop, Leap Conventions, leapevent, or Pastimes.
Never modify Gmail state during monitoring.
